description: Defines classes for high and low container metrics related to RLC transmission, including methods for adding metrics, resetting, and retrieving them, with support for different RLC modes.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_high_container
classes.description: Container for high-level RLC transmission metrics, with enable control and methods to add, get, reset, and retrieve metrics.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_low_container
classes.description: Container for low-level RLC transmission metrics supporting multiple RLC modes, with methods to set mode, add various metrics, reset, and retrieve metrics.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the metrics container is enabled.

methods.name: metrics_add_sdus
methods.description: Adds SDUs metrics to the high container.

methods.name: metrics_add_lost_sdus
methods.description: Records lost SDUs in the high container.

methods.name: metrics_add_discard
methods.description: Records discarded SDUs.

methods.name: metrics_add_discard_failure
methods.description: Records discard failures.

methods.name: get_hi_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves high container metrics, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: reset_metrics
methods.description: Resets high container metrics.

methods.name: get_and_reset_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves and resets high container metrics.

methods.name: metrics_set_mode
methods.description: Sets the mode-specific metrics container based on RLC mode.

methods.name: metrics_add_pdus_no_segmentation
methods.description: Adds metrics for PDUs without segmentation.

methods.name: metrics_add_pulled_sdus
methods.description: Records pulled SDUs.

methods.name: metrics_add_sdu_latency_us
methods.description: Adds SDU latency in microseconds.

methods.name: metrics_add_pdu_latency_ns
methods.description: Adds PDU latency in nanoseconds, updates histogram and max latency.

methods.name: metrics_add_small_alloc
methods.description: Adds small allocation metrics for TM mode.

methods.name: metrics_add_pdus_with_segmentation_um
methods.description: Adds segmentation metrics for UM mode.

methods.name: metrics_add_pdus_with_segmentation_am
methods.description: Adds segmentation metrics for AM mode.

methods.name: metrics_add_retx_pdus
methods.description: Adds retransmitted PDUs metrics.

methods.name: metrics_add_ctrl_pdus
methods.description: Adds control PDUs metrics.

methods.name: metrics_add_ack_latency_ms
methods.description: Records ACK latency in milliseconds.

methods.name: metrics_add_handle_status_latency_us
methods.description: Records handle status latency in microseconds, updates max and min.

methods.name: metrics_add_t_poll_retransmission_expiry_latency_us
methods.description: Records T-Poll retransmission expiry latency.

methods.name: get_low_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves low container metrics, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: reset_metrics
methods.description: Resets low container metrics.

methods.name: get_and_reset_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves and resets low container metrics.
